# SecDim

**The second dimension of spatial association**

Please cite **SecDim** as:

> Song, Y. (2022). The second dimension of spatial association. *Journal
> of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation*,*111*, 102834.
> <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102834>.

A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is:

``` bib
@Article{Song_2022,
    title = {The second dimension of spatial association},
    author = {Song Yongze},
    year = {2022},
    month = {jul},
    volume = {111},
    pages = {102834},
    journal = {International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation},
    issn = {1569-8432},
    publisher = {Elsevier BV},
    doi = {10.1016/j.jag.2022.102834},
    url = {https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jag.2022.102834},
  }
```

## Installation

- Install from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=SecDim) with:

``` r
install.packages("SecDim")
```

- Install development binary version from
  [r-universe](https://ausgis.r-universe.dev/SecDim) with:

``` r
install.packages('SecDim',repos = c("https://ausgis.r-universe.dev",
                                    "https://cran.rstudio.com/"))
```

- Install development source version from
  [GitHub](https://github.com/ausgis/SecDim) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ausgis/SecDim", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

# Package index

## Utils

- [`selectvarlm()`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/selectvarlm.md)
  : Selecting variables using linear regression
- [`gsdvar()`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/gsdvar.md) :
  Generating second-dimension variables for a spatial variable
- [`sdapredvars()`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/sdapredvars.md)
  : Preparing explanatory variables data for SDA-based prediction
- [`selectvarsda()`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/selectvarsda.md)
  : Selecting variables for the SDA model
- [`rmvoutlier()`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/rmvoutlier.md)
  : Removing outliers.
- [`vif()`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/vif.md) : Fast
  calculation of the variance inflation factor (VIF)

## Data

- [`obs`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/obs.md) : Spatial
  datasets of trace elements.
- [`grids`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/grids.md) :
  Spatial grid dataset.
- [`sample_vars_fda`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/sample_vars_fda.md)
  : Spatial datasets of the first dimension variables of trace elements.
- [`sample_vars_sda`](https://ausgis.github.io/SecDim/reference/sample_vars_sda.md)
  : Spatial datasets of the second dimension variables of trace
  elements.
